citations.quote: Use service_not_received for an authorized purchase whose promised service was not supplied.
Routing precedence: manual_review for unsupported/ambiguous cases or unavailable transaction service;
Never treat service failure as an empty transaction history. Retry a transient failure at most twice
I paid Morrow Supplies 270 crowns for a service. It has not been delivered. I want to understand what information you need.

The transactions call was skipped because its circuit breaker was open after earlier cases exhausted every attempt. Merchant display name from the tool: Morrow Supplies.
